method.portfolio: equal weight of one listing per issuer, the listing with the highest trailing ADV
method.universes: liquid: every issuer above the ADV floor; small: bottom 30% by point-in-time market cap, financials excluded, after the ADV floor
method.liquidity: 60-session median BRL volume, at least 20 prints, a print within 5 sessions
method.rebalance: signal at the month-end or quarter-end close, fill at the next session
method.costs: B3 taker fee, half-spread and participation slippage from trading_costs.quote_fill, cap 5000 bps
method.cash: idle cash earns 0; CDI is a benchmark, not a credit inside the book
method.dividends: Cash credited to shares held at the previous close. Labeled dividends are untaxed. Labeled interest on equity is withheld at 15%. Unlabeled events, which are the public chart feed, are withheld at 15% on the selection path. A registered sensitivity withholds nothing on unlabeled events. An amount larger than the previous close is dropped. The feed is not a per-share dividend at that size.
method.splits: A round gap of at least 45% changes the share count only when a later capital filing confirms the inverse change
method.delist: A name with no print for 10 sessions is sold at the last trade on the base path. A registered sensitivity marks that exit worthless
method.survivorship: The cadastral form names a ticker only from the 2018 vintage onward, and that row can carry an earlier start date. Every standard-lot COTAHIST name missing from the form is still listed, from its first print to its last. A 4-letter root already tied to a company keeps that company. A root with no filing has no share count, so it can enter the liquid book and cannot enter the small-cap book. No cash distribution is invented when the chart feed has no event for a name that stopped trading.

dividend_coverage.source: Yahoo Finance chart events, grossed up by splits that the same feed reports after the ex-date. The feed does not label interest on equity separately from dividends, so those rows are kind=unknown.
dividend_coverage.gap: A name that stopped trading and has no event understates the total return if it paid cash before it left. No cash is invented for that gap. The price-only rows are the lower bound that ignores every distribution.

oos_split.rule: Among the eight sleeves at R$ 1 million (liquid or small, two ADV floors, monthly or quarterly), choose the highest net Sharpe on month-ends through 2018-12-31, with at least 36 months. Ties break to higher design CAGR, lower turnover, monthly, a higher ADV floor, then liquid. Wealth variants and audit variants are registered and counted in N, and cannot be chosen. The path is not flattened at the split.
oos_split.criterion: DSR >= 0.95 on the out-of-sample net monthly returns, N = this family plus the 32 rejected net-net trials, AND out-of-sample net CAGR minus CDI CAGR > 0

published_small_cap_audit.definition: Non-financial issuers with a point-in-time balance sheet, one ordinary listing, the most liquid line, bottom 30% by market capitalisation, phase-0 calendar (first session of every fourth month) from 2012-05-02, price return, R$ 1 million, resize rather than a round trip. This is the published path.

benchmark_ibov.note: Official Ibovespa level (B3 defines it as a gross total-return index, so cash dividends are already reinvested in the published series). No extra dividend was added. No investor cost.

benchmark_ibov_oos.note: Official Ibovespa level (B3 defines it as a gross total-return index, so cash dividends are already reinvested in the published series). No extra dividend was added. No investor cost.

benchmark_cdi.unit: daily percent converted to a decimal, compounded on (start, end]
benchmark_cdi.note: CDI is the opportunity cost. The book does not earn it on idle cash.

corporate_action_rule_v2.note: Every number above this key is the published v1 study. That study confirmed a round price jump only when a capital filing arrived after the print. v2 removes that window and was not executed in this change because the COTAHIST cache is not in the checkout.
corporate_action_rule_v2.command: python scripts/fetch_net_net_b3.py --cache data/net-net && python scripts/fetch_equal_weight_dividends.py --cache data/net-net --out data/equal-weight/yahoo --refresh-splits && python scripts/run_equal_weight_b3.py --cache data/net-net --events data/equal-weight/yahoo
